app.name: A mano
app.description: Everyday tools that work offline and stay out of your way.
app.tagline: Your everyday tools, always within reach.

foot.text: Works offline. Your data stays on your device.

allHidden.title: No tools to show
allHidden.message: You've hidden all of them in Settings. You can bring them back whenever you like.

soon.title: Not ready yet
soon.message: This one arrives in the next phase. The card is already here so you can see where it will live.

failed.title: Couldn't open this tool
failed.message: Give it another go. If it keeps failing, check for updates in Settings.

temporizador.name: Timer
temporizador.desc: Countdown and pomodoro, with an alert when time is up.

listas.name: Tasks & notes
listas.desc: To-dos, shopping list and quick notes in one place.

unidades.name: Unit converter
unidades.desc: Length, weight, temperature, volume and more.

contrasenas.name: Passwords
contrasenas.desc: Build strong passwords exactly how you want them.

contador-texto.name: Word counter
contador-texto.desc: Words, characters, sentences and reading time.

monedas.name: Currency converter
monedas.desc: Convert between currencies using the latest saved rate.

zonas-horarias.name: Time zones
zonas-horarias.desc: The time in other cities, plus a meeting-time converter.

azar.name: Random picker
azar.desc: Coin, dice, spinner and random numbers.

qr.name: QR codes
qr.desc: Make QR codes for text, links or wifi, right on your device.

colores.name: Colour picker
colores.desc: HEX, RGB, HSL, WCAG contrast and saved swatches.

equipos.name: Team picker
equipos.desc: Split a list of names into fair, random teams.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Changes are saved as you make them.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Dark by default. “System” follows your device setting.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.desc: Used for buttons, links and active items.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.desc: Turns off transitions and movement. Your system preference is respected too.

language.title: Language
language.label: App language
language.desc: Takes effect straight away, no reload needed.

time.label: Time format
time.desc: How times are shown throughout the app.

date.label: Date format
date.desc: The order of day, month and year.

currency.label: Default currency
currency.desc: What the currency converter starts with.

units.label: Unit system
units.desc: Starting preference for the unit converter.

tools.title: Tools
tools.lead: Choose which ones appear on the home screen, and in what order.

focus.label: Pomodoro length
focus.desc: Minutes of focus in each round.

longBreak.label: Long break
longBreak.desc: Minutes once the rounds are done.

rounds.label: Rounds before a long break
rounds.desc: How many pomodoros in a row.

sound.label: Sound when time is up
sound.desc: A short chime at the end.

notify.label: Notify when time is up
notify.desc: Alerts you even if the app is in the background.
notify.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Change it in your browser's site permissions.

export.label: Backup
export.desc: Download everything as a single JSON file.

import.label: Restore a backup
import.desc: The file is checked before anything is applied. This replaces your current data.
import.confirmMessage: Everything currently stored in the app will be replaced by the contents of the file.
import.invalid: That file isn't a valid backup from this app

clear.label: Delete all local data
clear.desc: Settings, favourites and everything your tools have saved on this device.
clear.confirmMessage: This can't be undone. Everything saved on this device will be gone.

blocked.title: Storage is blocked
blocked.message: This browser won't let the app save anything (private mode or site permissions). The app still works, but it will forget everything when you close it.

guest.label: Guest mode
guest.desc: Everything works without an account. Your data stays on this device.

pending.title: Sync isn't available yet
pending.message: Signing in to share the same data between your phone and computer arrives in phase 3.

about.title: About

install.label: Install the app
install.desc: Add it to your home screen or desktop.
install.unavailable: Your browser doesn't offer installation here, or the app is already installed.
install.howto: On iPhone and iPad: Share button → “Add to Home Screen”.

update.label: Check for updates
update.desc: See whether a newer version has been published.
update.unsupported: This browser doesn't support background updates

about.sourceLabel: Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no frameworks.

connection.offlineHint: Carry on as usual: everything here works offline.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: The short version: this app doesn't track you, and without an account nothing leaves your device.

local.title: What's stored on your device
items: Your settings: theme, accent, language, formats and tool preferences.
Your favourites and the order of the tools.
Whatever you create in each tool — tasks, notes, lists, history.
All of it in the browser's local storage, under the “amano:” prefix.

none.title: What doesn't happen
items: No analytics, no tracking cookies, no ads.
None of your content is sent to a server.
No permission is requested unless you turn that feature on first.

network.title: When the internet is used
items: The first time you open the app, to download it and store it for offline use.
To check for updates to the app itself.
The currency converter will fetch public exchange rates once it's available.

control.title: What you control
items: Export a copy of your data at any time from Settings → Data.
Delete everything stored on this device with one button — there's no undo.

privacy.contact: This app is published as a static website, so whoever hosts it only sees ordinary web requests.

licenses.title: Licences
licenses.lead: Third-party libraries bundled inside the project so the app keeps working offline.
licenses.empty: No third-party libraries yet — every line here is our own.

notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.message: The link you followed doesn't exist, or it has moved.

offlinePage.title: You're offline
offlinePage.message: We couldn't load this part of the app, and there's no connection right now.
